notes: •  FIXED: the "Update now" bar could get stuck when a newer build had been published since the bar appeared - it kept trying to install the version the bar first named and failed on a size/checksum mismatch. MxScout now re-reads the release list the moment you click Update now and installs whatever is newest right then. If a newer build has already been installed, it simply says you are up to date instead of failing.
